hook_structure: direct how-to promise + escalating-stat proof: 'here's how' spoken cold-open immediately paired with a climbing on-screen counter (88→100 'TikToks per hour') to visually dramatize the claim before the tool is even named

beats.read: Cold open on the speaker's face with a bold white caption locking in the promise before any cut, so viewers commit before the payoff is shown.

beats.cutaway_subject: animated counter graphic (TikTok logo + numbers ticking 88→100) and an AI chip icon, layered over a blurred freeze of the speaker
beats.read: The face is defocused and pushed to background so the escalating counter card becomes the sole legible element, manufacturing urgency around volume before any explanation.
Sharp cut back to the presenter's face signals the tutorial is now starting for real, re-establishing trust after the stat interlude.

beats.cutaway_subject: screen recording of typing 'sub' then 'submagic.co' into a browser, followed by the Submagic upload UI with the speaker's own clip loaded
beats.read: A literal screen-record cutaway proves the step by showing the exact URL and click path rather than just telling it.

beats.cutaway_subject: looping night-time cobblestone alley b-roll (stock 'a man working' clip) sharing frame with a picture-in-picture insert of the speaker; a phone prop is briefly held in his mouth
beats.card_text: HERE'S HOW / SECONDS / CAN USE TIKTOK / IT'LL GENERATE / IN AI TO / CAPTIONS / WANT TO / HIT 10-K PER MONTH / IN THE FACE / MORE THAN / SOME OF / POPULAR / IN JUST / THREE SIMPLE
beats.read: Split-screen PIP keeps the face present for authority while the metaphorical b-roll illustrates the abstract '10K/month, faceless' claim, with word-by-word colored captions (green/white/purple) driving pace and emphasis.
A snap cut to full-frame face on 'but' flags a pivot line, using the mechanical cut to physically punctuate the turn in the script.

beats.cutaway_subject: screen recording of Submagic's caption/B-roll editor panel, cursor clicking the 'Magic B-rolls' button
beats.card_text: BEST PART / JUST CLICK / AUTO B-ROLL
beats.read: Immediate second cut into UI proof right after the 'but' turn, showing the actual click that makes the promised feature feel real and easy.
Cut back to full-frame face resets attention to the presenter as he begins listing the auto-added features.
Feature icons (magnifier, transition arrow, speaker) stack up over the same warm-graded talking-head shot to visually tally the growing feature list without needing new footage.

beats.cutaway_subject: close-up b-roll of hands counting cash on a desk, with the same icon row (zoom/transition/sound/camera) persisting on top
beats.read: The money b-roll doubles as both the 'b-roll clips' example and a subliminal wealth cue, tying the feature demo back to the earlier income claim.
Mechanical cut returns to a clean full-frame shot for the superlative pitch line, with 'TOOL' and 'INSANELY' styled in colored/bold text to carry emphasis the voice alone can't show on camera.

beats.cutaway_subject: full-bleed return of the night alley b-roll, no PIP this time
beats.card_text: A MAN WORKING WELL / FOR HIMSELF IS RESPECTED / FOR FACELESS
beats.read: Dropping the PIP and letting the metaphor b-roll fill the whole frame raises intensity right as the script reaches its thesis about faceless creators being respected.

beats.cutaway_subject: same alley b-roll now shrunk back into a split panel beside the reappearing talking-head insert
beats.card_text: ON TIKTOK AND BUT DON'T / WANT TO SHOW YOUR PERSONAL
beats.read: Re-introducing the face alongside the metaphor visually bridges back from the abstract clip to the personal 'don't want to show your face' pivot line.

beats.card_text: SO IF / LEVEL UP / YOUR CONTENT / BUT DON'T / WANNA HIRE / EDITOR
beats.read: Cut settles into a sustained clean talking-head close for the direct-address payoff line, letting per-word color changes (white/purple split on 'YOUR CONTENT', purple 'EDITOR') carry emphasis without further visual noise.
Brand logo cards drop in over the still-talking face as a soft CTA, naming the product explicitly right before the video ends.

beats.cutaway_subject: TikTok app loading/search animation with the search bar auto-filling '@kellanhenneberry...'
beats.read: Hard cut to a mocked-up TikTok search screen acts as a built-in follow prompt; it holds static for the final ~4 seconds with no further treatment, a deliberate bare hold to let viewers read/tap before the video loops.
